name: The Moon Adventures of Apollo Starlight
summary: Embark on an interstellar journey like no other - a captivating 2D game that blends retro charm with modern excitement. Join the fearless astronaut, Apollo Starlight, as he explores the mysterious lunar landscapes, encountering enigmatic aliens, and completing thrilling objectives.
